name: Atlantic Mackerel
text_excerpt: The (Scomber scombrus), also known as the Boston mackerel, Norwegian mackerel, Scottish mackerel, or just mackerel, is a species of mackerel that inhabit the temperate waters of the Mediterranean Sea, the Black Sea, and the northern Atlantic Ocean. It is a highly commercial fish that is sought after for its meat, being strong in flavor and high in oil content and omega-3 fatty acids among other nutrients. Its body is elongated, steel-blue marked with wavy black lines dorsally and silvery-white ventrally, in addition to a long and pointed snout. It has two spiny dorsal fins, two pectoral fins, and small caudal and anal fins. name: Bahariasaurus
text_excerpt: (meaning "Bahariya lizard") is a genus of theropod dinosaur that lived in North Africa during the Late Cretaceous period around 95 million years ago. Very little is known about Bahariasaurus as only a small number of hipbones have been found. Even those were lost, however, when Allied bombs destroyed the German museum where the bones were housed during WWII. A number of these bones were found by German paleontologists shortly before WWI. In the early 1930's they were named Bahariasaurus and identified as coming from a huge carnivore. WWI ended the original search for the specimen and WWII destroyed what had been found. Some scientists have suggested that Bahariasaurus may have been part of the Tyrannosauridae family. However, no Tyrannosauroid has been recorded in Africa. Others believe that Deltadromeus should be a junior synonym of Bahariasaurus.Most of the information comes from Jurassic Park Institute. His exploits were legendary, making him a hero to the English but a pirate to the Spaniards to whom he was known as El Draque. Satisfied with the fruits of her journey, she returned home with the child.Indiana Jones Artifacts A few years later, as Achilles grew, an oracle foretold that he would die beneath the walls of Troy from a wound in his heel, the only vulnerable part of his body.
